showIndex.description: Show the index as root album. An index is a media source directory and is the parent of all its albums. By default only its subdirectories are listed

showCover.description: Show a cover thumbnail of the album. The cover is the first media of the album or of its first sub-album. A media whose file name ends with '_cover' before its extension is preferred

thumbnailSize.description: Initial size of the album thumbnails. Smaller thumbnails show more albums per row in the grid view and shorter rows in the list view. It is overruled by the size controls of the nav bar

order.description: Initial album order. It is overruled by the order of the page

view.description: Initial album view. The list view shows the album tree, the grid view shows all albums as squared cover thumbnails. It is overruled by the view toggle of the page

recentDays.description: Mark albums whose media were added to the gallery within this amount of days. An album with only recently added media is marked as new, an album with some of them as updated. 0 disables the marks. A media is added when the file index finds its file the first time, so all albums of a new gallery are new for these days. A database which was built by an older version needs a rebuild by 'gallery database'
